source: Status changes to Spinach Questions rows after the answer set, each by a commit (yeslyf_phase14_brief.md: the status word changes only by a commit). scripts/import_sq.py applies them after reading the answer set and writes each one into the row's log; the answer text never changes here.
note: Fields: id; status (frozen, open, owed); item (the to be decided or to be verified item; empty until given); owner and due (open and owed rows; due_about true while the date is a proposal); date (yyyy-mm-dd; becomes the row's changed date); cause; note (what happened, in a few words).
